operations.title: Entry 1244 — All Compatible Five-Site Multi-Wall Active Sets Inherit Pair Closure
operations.body: Any source-compatible active set of size at least three contains a compatible triple, and every compatible triple contains a unit or t=0 pair by Entry 1243. Hence all active sets of sizes 3 through 10 inherit pair closure. Together with the one-wall and pair censuses, the complete source-compatible Landau search on the frozen cyclic slice adds no divisor beyond the one-wall polynomial.

operations.title: Benincasa closes all active-set sizes by hereditary pair closure
operations.body: Entry 1244: no higher hypergraph census is needed. Every compatible set |S|>=3 contains a compatible triple, and every triple contains a closed pair. Therefore all active sizes 1..10 are closed. On the frozen cyclic slice, genuine Landau support is bounded by Entry 1235's one-wall polynomial. The next question is the scalar period/Picard-Fuchs module and apparent versus intrinsic operator singularities.

authority_basis.summary: Repair the unnecessary hypergraph frontier and record hereditary closure of all compatible five-site multi-wall active sets.
